policy.budgetEstimator: ceil(UTF-8 packet bytes / 3); not model tokens
policy.dependency: one-hop relative import and reverse import from top three lexical files, score 0.7 seed
policy.ast: query identifier words substring-match current indexJavaScript symbol names; same 60-line output units
policy.lexical: BM25 k1=1.2 b=0.75; path repeated twice; lowercase identifier-split words; no learned query rewrite
policy.hybrid: 0.5 normalized lexical + 0.25 normalized AST + 0.25 normalized dependency
policy.packing: rank descending, path/start tie break, deduplicate source lines, skip oversized units; include packet headers in budget
